findings.title: Executed functional_correctness gate exits 1 on the frozen candidate (deduplicated: A BLOCKER + B-01)
findings.evidence: Host-executed gate record in the evidence summary: functional_correctness: FAIL exit=1 duration=66173ms evidence=ev_dc53180c89d646faacd1b40f154ae3a3 candidate=ddc3550bfd2b, against revision rev_338165ad478e4a46bc80c5a1c90286dc. The sole reviewed change is the hunk @@ -74,6 +74,14 @@ in src/styles.css adding `position: static; left: auto; top: auto` to `.pricing-card__cta`; no gate, golden, or test files appear among the changed files, so the executed FAIL applies to this candidate state rather than an unrelated revision.
findings.counterexample: Run the required functional acceptance on the frozen candidate rev_338165ad478e4a46bc80c5a1c90286dc: the gate exits 1 (ev_dc53180c89d646faacd1b40f154ae3a3). Therefore the 460x460 scrollbar-free stage, the CTA-inside-card golden comparison, and the click-to-'Plan selected'-toast behavior are not simultaneously reproduced. If resetting `position` to `static` were the complete fix, the executed gate would exit 0.
findings.requirement: M6 acceptance: CTA visible inside the pricing card, 460x460 stage renders without scrollbars, clicking the CTA produces the 'Plan selected' toast; visual golden plus functional click must pass and gates must not be weakened.
findings.verification: Read the failure output of ev_dc53180c89d646faacd1b40f154ae3a3, then re-run functional_correctness against rev_338165ad478e4a46bc80c5a1c90286dc requiring exit=0 with a golden-vs-rendered artifact and a post-click toast assertion (plus post-completion interactivity) before any PASS.

findings.title: No visual artifact proves in-card CTA placement, scrollbar-free 460x460 stage, or the post-click toast; the only attachment is a card crop without stage chrome
findings.evidence: Attachment 0-pricing-card.png is a card-only crop with no viewport bounds, stage chrome, or scrollbar region visible; it therefore cannot evidence the 460x460 stage requirement or where the CTA sits relative to the container. The diff adds `position: static; left: auto; top: auto` to `.pricing-card__cta` at src/styles.css:77-85, but no golden-vs-rendered comparison artifact or post-click toast capture is present in the evidence; artifact_provenance evidence ev_97aad9bfd05d4ebeacc6b8eb7278bb10 covers provenance only, not the visual or interaction states.
findings.counterexample: Render the component at a fixed 460x460 stage: with no stage-bounded screenshot or scrollbar check, the CTA could still be clipped or the stage could overflow without detection; a click on the CTA could fail to insert the 'Plan selected' toast and nothing in the evidence would reveal it, because the crop shows only a static card and stops before any click or terminal-state interaction.
findings.requirement: Requirement image/m6 states: CTA visible inside the card within a scrollbar-free 460x460 stage, and clicking the CTA shows the 'Plan selected' toast, with evidence at each named state (placement, no-scroll, post-click) rather than a static card crop.
findings.verification: Produce a 460x460 stage screenshot showing the full stage bounds and absence of scrollbars, a golden-diff artifact against the requirement image, and a post-click capture plus DOM assertion of the 'Plan selected' toast with the UI remaining interactive (Replay/Close/click/keyboard) after the terminal frame.

findings.title: `left: auto` and `top: auto` are inert while `position: static`, and the golden assertion is self-referential
findings.evidence: The hunk adds `position: static; left: auto; top: auto` to `.pricing-card__cta` at src/styles.css:81-84. Per CSS positioned-layout semantics, left/top offsets do not apply to statically positioned boxes, so only `position: static` can have an effect on this element; the reset of `left`/`top` cannot by itself correct any offset. No golden capture artifact is present in the frozen evidence, so the claimed golden comparison cannot be independently validated.
findings.counterexample: A reviewer points at the serialized reset `left: auto; top: auto` as the fix for CTA displacement, but under `position: static` those declarations are ignored, so any observed correction must derive from `position: static` or unrelated properties; if the real displacement came from another declaration (e.g. margins, transforms, or flex/grid placement), the added left/top resets mask nothing and the layout can regress while the diff still appears to contain a fix.
findings.requirement: M6 fix must actually produce the required CTA placement with evidence, not merely serialize position-related declarations whose left/top components are inert.
findings.verification: Compute/document the used values of `position`, `left`, and `top` for `.pricing-card__cta` in the rendered stage (devtools or computed-style assertion) and compare the CTA bounding box before/after the change against the golden, showing which declaration actually moved the element.
